issue_body:
* lab diff --quiet prints stuff out, ie logger is spitting out

```
lab diff --quiet 
INFO 2024-03-23 10:44:05,711 generate_data.py:625 Found new taxonomy files:
INFO 2024-03-23 10:44:05,711 generate_data.py:627 * compositional_skills/writing/freeform/jokes/puns-copy/general/qna.yaml
WARNING 2024-03-23 10:44:05,723 generate_data.py:544 Cannot find yaml_rules.yaml. Using default rules.
Taxonomy in taxonomy is valid :)
```

We probably want an exit code 0 or 1 without anything being printed out. 

* refractor `generator.generate_data.read_taxonomy` to only raise exception, instead of using `SystemExit`, so that caller functions can catch those exceptions and deal with them as they see fit.
